chunks.text: On the 2013-2018 CB500F, coolant at the weep hole with no drips can be watched. If it starts to drip, replace the mechanical seal.
On the 2013-2018 CB500F, oil along the clutch cover seam is usually the gasket. Replace the clutch cover gasket. Confirm the bolt torque in the service manual.

causes.name: Coolant at the water-pump weep hole
Oil leak from clutch cover gasket

repair_steps: Monitor the weep hole for any coolant drips. If dripping occurs, replace the water pump mechanical seal.
Inspect the clutch cover seam for oil leaks. If oil is present, replace the clutch cover gasket.
